NFL DFS Quarterback Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 10:22 AM ET

Jared Goff is the top-projected quarterback on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 20.5 DraftKings points for $6,800, against Green Bay. Brock Purdy (19.9, $6,600) and C.J. Stroud (18.9, $5,700) are next.

Tyler Huntley returns the most per dollar among quarterbacks projected for at least 15 points: 3.54 projected points per $1,000 at $4,900.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 10:22 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Quarterbacks to know in Week 7

Jared Goff, DET vs GB ($6,800)

Jared Goff carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.5 DraftKings points at $6,800. That is 0.5 points clear of Brock Purdy. The salary works out to 3.01 projected points per $1,000, 13th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.1 and a ceiling of 37.7, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Brock Purdy, SF at ATL ($6,600)

Brock Purdy projects 2nd at the position with 19.9 DraftKings points at $6,600. The model includes 4.2 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.02 projected points per $1,000, 11th of 17 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 36.6, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Value: Tyler Huntley, BAL vs CIN ($4,900)

Tyler Huntley projects for 17.4 DraftKings points at $4,900, which works out to 3.54 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 17 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 4.4 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Huntley averaged 17.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 32.1, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 3-point underdog at home against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 21.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.
